dict.string: cerberus needs permission to automate apps such as Mail only when you ask it to.
cerberus reads calendar events when you ask scheduling questions.
cerberus listens only after you trigger a voice interaction.
cerberus reads reminders and creates reminders only after confirmation.
cerberus reads visible screen text only when you ask what is on screen.
cerberus uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your requests.
